definitions.gloss: sound of wings; flapping or buzzing sound of wings
definitions.explanation: The sound made by the wings of birds or insects in flight. Can refer to flapping, beating, or buzzing sounds depending on the creature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽音|はおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard the sound of a bird's wings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽音|はおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{耳元|みみもと}→耳元：28311_mimimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鳴|な}っている→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The buzzing of a bee is sounding near my ear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{羽音|はおと}がして⟦{見上|みあ}げる→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{白鷺|しらさぎ}→白鷺：28731_shirasagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}び{立|た}つ→飛び立つ：19322_tobitatsu⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧だった。
examples.english: In the quiet forest, there was suddenly a loud sound of wings, and when I looked up, a white heron was taking flight.

notes:
{羽音|はおと} is a compound of {羽|はね} (wing/feather) + ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ (sound). It refers to any sound produced by wings in motion.

USAGE:
The sound described varies by creature:
- ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽音|はおと}: flapping of bird wings (heavier, rhythmic)
- ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽音|はおと}: buzzing of bee/wasp wings (high-pitched, continuous)
- ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽音|はおと}: flutter of butterfly wings (very faint)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羽音|はおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a wing sound is heard
- {羽音|はおと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to produce the sound of wings
- {羽音|はおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear the sound of wings

REGISTER:
Frequently used in literature and nature writing. It is evocative and somewhat poetic, more common in written descriptions than in everyday conversation.
